operators.name: isnan_forward
semantics: Computes element-wise torch.isnan on input float32 tensor, returning bool tensor of same shape.
Input is CUDA tensor of shape [128,64,15360] with stride (983040,15360,1).
Output bool tensor must have same stride and device CUDA.

operators.name: batch_norm_forward
semantics: Applies 1D batch normalization over channel dimension (dim=1) for input shape [N,C,L] with N=128, C=64, L=15360.
If training=True, uses batch mean/var with unbiased variance; if training=False, uses running_mean/running_var.
Affine transformation: y = weight * (x - mean) / sqrt(var + eps) + bias when weight/bias are not None; otherwise identity scale/shift.
BatchNorm1d reduces over dimensions 0 and 2, maintaining per-channel statistics (C=64).
Input and output are CUDA float32, stride (983040,15360,1).
Element-wise NaN check on input float32 CUDA tensor, producing bool tensor of identical shape and stride.
No broadcasting or reduction; preserves input shape.
BatchNorm1d over channel dim for input [128,64,15360], using module parameters weight, bias, running_mean, running_var, eps=1e-5, momentum=0.1, affine=True, track_running_stats=True.
In eval mode (training=False), uses running statistics: y = weight * (x - running_mean) / sqrt(running_var + eps) + bias.
Reduction axes are all except channel dimension; output shape identical to input.
Returns tuple (normalized_x, nan_mask) where normalized_x is float32 CUDA tensor [128,64,15360], nan_mask is bool CUDA tensor [128,64,15360].
